# Security Policy

## Supported versions

This is a student/portfolio project. Only the latest version on the `main` branch is maintained.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|:---------:|
| Latest (`main`) | Yes |
| Older commits | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for security problems.

Instead, use GitHub's private reporting:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/laveshparyani/Payroll-System/security).
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Describe the issue, the steps to reproduce it, and the potential impact.

You can expect an acknowledgement within a few days. Thank you for helping keep the project safe.

## Notes on this project

This app was written as a learning exercise. It intentionally documents known hardening areas (for example password hashing and fully parameterised queries) as part of its ongoing improvement, rather than claiming to be production-secure.
